item.title: Welcome
item.content:
This site is a home for my work as a cellist and conductor — performances, recordings, and the occasional written reflection on the music I'm working on.

If you're looking for upcoming shows, you'll find them on the shows page. For recordings and concert recordings, see music, and for photos from recent concerts, gallery.

More to come as the season unfolds.
